alt_text: A gold frequency ring glows around the NDCH arch-and-Y emblem on black stone veined with gold, under the title I TAKE CARE OF MYSELF, NDCH FREQ 004. The picture pushes in slowly and the gold breathes brighter while one line repeats: I look after myself.
